name: Basic Martingale EA 3
summary: A basic martingale Expert Advisor that doubles the lot size after each losing trade, aiming to recover previous losses with a single winning trade. It enters positions based on simple signal logic and relies on the martingale progression to eventually achieve net profit. The strategy carries extreme risk of account blow-up during prolonged losing streaks.
summary_zh: 一个基础马丁格尔智能交易系统，在每次亏损后将手数翻倍，试图通过一次盈利交易来弥补之前所有亏损。它基于简单信号逻辑入场，并依赖马丁格尔倍投机制最终实现净盈利。该策略在持续亏损期间存在账户爆仓的极端风险。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的马丁格尔策略概念，核心思想是在每次亏损后将下一笔交易的手数翻倍，使得一次盈利即可覆盖之前所有亏损并获利。入场条件通常基于简单的技术指标信号或固定条件触发，没有复杂的过滤机制。出场条件主要依赖止盈目标，当累计盈利达到设定水平时平仓获利。仓位管理采用几何级数递增方式，手数按照2的幂次增长（0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.08...），这导致风险呈指数级放大。资金管理方面，EA通常不设置全局止损或最大回撤限制，使得账户在连续亏损时面临爆仓危险。整体策略缺乏对市场趋势和波动性的适应性，在震荡市中可能短期获利，但在单边行情中将遭受毁灭性损失。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs the classic martingale strategy concept, where the core idea is to double the lot size after each losing trade so that a single winning trade can cover all previous losses and generate profit. Entry conditions are typically based on simple technical indicator signals or fixed condition triggers without sophisticated filtering mechanisms. Exit conditions primarily rely on a take-profit target, closing positions when cumulative profit reaches a set level. Position sizing follows a geometric progression, with lots increasing by powers of two (0.01, 0.02, 0.04, 0.08...), causing risk to escalate exponentially. Money management is essentially absent — the EA typically lacks a global stop-loss or maximum drawdown limit, leaving the account vulnerable to complete depletion during consecutive losing streaks. The overall strategy lacks adaptability to market trends and volatility; it may profit in ranging markets but will suffer catastrophic losses in trending conditions.

parameters.name: InitialLot
parameters.description: 初始手数，马丁格尔起始仓位
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, Martingale starting position

pros: 在震荡行情中理论上可以持续盈利，每次倍投后盈利即可覆盖前期亏损
代码逻辑简单易懂，适合初学者理解马丁格尔策略的基本原理
参数可调，用户可以自定义倍增系数和最大手数限制
pros_en: Theoretically profitable in ranging markets since a single win after doubling can cover all prior losses
Simple and understandable code logic, suitable for beginners to learn the fundamentals of martingale strategy
Configurable parameters allow users to customize the multiplier factor and maximum lot size limit
cons: 指数级手数增长在连续亏损时极易导致账户爆仓，风险不可控
缺乏全局止损和最大回撤保护机制，无法限制极端亏损
没有市场趋势过滤和波动率适应机制，在单边行情中必然遭受重大损失
过度依赖统计回归假设，但真实市场序列相关性和黑天鹅事件使该假设不成立
cons_en: Exponential lot growth during consecutive losses can easily blow up the account with uncontrollable risk
Lacks a global stop-loss and maximum drawdown protection mechanism, unable to limit extreme losses
No market trend filter or volatility adaptation mechanism, guaranteed to suffer major losses in trending markets
Over-relies on statistical regression assumptions which fail under real-world serial correlation and black swan events
improvements: 增加全局最大回撤限制和账户权益保护机制，当回撤超过阈值时停止交易
加入趋势过滤指标（如EMA或ADX），在趋势行情中暂停马丁格尔倍投
设置最大连续亏损次数限制，达到上限后重置手数而非继续倍增
improvements_en: Add a global maximum drawdown limit and account equity protection mechanism that halts trading when drawdown exceeds a threshold
Incorporate trend filtering indicators (e.g., EMA or ADX) to pause martingale doubling during trending market conditions
Set a maximum consecutive loss count limit that resets the lot size instead of continuing to double when the limit is reached

risk_points: 马丁格尔倍投导致手数指数增长，连续亏损时账户爆仓概率极高
缺少止损或最大回撤保护，极端行情下可能全部亏损
无新K线检查可能导致同一根K线内多次开仓，加剧风险敞口
risk_points_en: Martingale doubling causes exponential lot growth, making account blow-up highly probable during consecutive losses
No stop-loss or maximum drawdown protection means total account loss is possible in extreme market conditions
Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries within the same bar, compounding risk exposure
